items.q: How do I book an appointment?
items.a: Use the Book button on any page. Choose your concern, doctor, day and time, and confirm with a one-time code sent to your mobile. You can also call the clinic.

If you know your problem, the booking form suggests the right specialist. If you are unsure, book a check-up with Dr. Sindhu and she will guide you.

items.q: Will I get a reminder before my appointment?
items.a: Yes. Online bookings are confirmed by email, and reminders are sent before the visit.
Yes. Children's check-ups, fluoride, sealants and pulp therapy for milk teeth are all offered.

items.q: What should I bring to my first visit?
items.a: A list of the medicines you take, any recent dental X-rays and reports, and your reading glasses if you use them for forms.

items.q: What if I have a dental emergency?
items.a: Call the clinic during opening hours. For heavy bleeding that won't stop, swelling that affects breathing or swallowing, or a facial injury, go to the nearest hospital emergency department.

items.q: Do I need to sign up to book?
items.a: No. You can book as a guest with your mobile number. Patients who prefer can create an account on the clinic's ClinicFlow247 page to see their appointments.
